final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT o.account_id, o.order_count, o.order_count - a.avg_count AS first_difference FROM order_counts AS o JOIN first_average AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE o.order_count > a.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.first_difference, k.order_count - a.avg_count AS second_difference FROM kept AS k JOIN second_average AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY second_difference IS NULL, second_difference DESC LIMIT 10
